verdict.rationale: Kong documents a provider-agnostic API that shields client apps from provider-specific APIs (docs-1, docs-29). It exposes llm/v1/chat and llm/v1/completions request formats (docs-8), and it can proxy existing AI CLI tools to LLM providers (docs-5). These point toward drop-in use, but nothing in the evidence explicitly says the API is OpenAI-compatible or that existing OpenAI SDK code works by changing only the base URL and key, and setup requires configuring AI Model Provider and AI Model entities. Missing for 10: an explicit OpenAI-compatible endpoint claim, a documented base-URL/key swap with an OpenAI SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
